subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal text/html stubs trigger best-effort Graph media lookup by default to recover channel/group attachments, or should that behavior require an explicit opt-in gate?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the repair changes when configured Teams channel/group messages request a Graph token and message fetch, and the reporter also suggested a possible per-channel setting.

options.title: Accept the linked fallback fix
options.body: Merge the plugin-owned fix once exact-head checks pass, accepting best-effort Graph lookup for non-personal Teams text/html stubs as the default recovery path.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask the fix PR to add or reuse a narrow operator-controlled setting before broadening Graph lookup for high-volume Teams deployments.

options.title: Pause for more tenant variants
options.body: Hold the fix until maintainers get fresh live proof for more channel, group-chat, private-channel, or permission-denied variants.

recommendation.title: Accept the linked fallback fix
recommendation.body: Merge the plugin-owned fix once exact-head checks pass, accepting best-effort Graph lookup for non-personal Teams text/html stubs as the default recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has substantial Microsoft Teams plugin-boundary history and is the best available owner for the product/API tradeoff among the related code-history candidates.
